# Faith Meredith

## Overview

- **Age:** 11 (volume 5)  <sub>[v5 c2 P29](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0029)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v5 c2 P28](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0028)</sub>
- **Status:** Alive  <sub>[v5 c35 P9](../source/v05-c35.md#nw-v05-c35-p0009)</sub>
- **Origin:** Maywater  <sub>[v5 c4 P46](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0046)</sub>
- **Role:** Student  <sub>[v5 c5 P0](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0000)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Red Rose  <sub>[v5 c16 P65](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0065), [v5 c17 P3](../source/v05-c17.md#nw-v05-c17-p0003)</sub>

## Appearance

Faith is a remarkably pretty girl with glowing crimson cheeks, golden-brown eyes, and golden-brown curls. She is tall and slender, and her expressive face is frequently illuminated by dimples and an easy, merry smile.

_Sources: [v5 c2 P29](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0029), [v5 c4 P6](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0006), [v5 c4 P41](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0041), [v5 c16 P53](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0053), [v5 c26 P22](../source/v05-c26.md#nw-v05-c26-p0022)_

## Personality

Faith is a vibrant, impulsive, and high-spirited girl who possesses a passionate love of fun and an abundance of 'spunk.' She is candid, warm-hearted, and intensely loyal to her family and friends, particularly protective of her father. Though her quick temper and thoughtless pranks occasionally lead her into trouble, she is thoroughly honest, generous, and quick to acknowledge her own faults.

_Sources: [v5 c2 P30](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0030), [v5 c2 P31](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0031), [v5 c2 P33](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0033), [v5 c16 P53](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0053), [v5 c16 P60](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0060), [v5 c26 P22](../source/v05-c26.md#nw-v05-c26-p0022)_

## History

Faith moved with her widowed father and siblings to the Glen St. Mary manse from Maywater. Left largely without maternal supervision under the care of their elderly, deaf relative Aunt Martha, she and her brothers and sister often ran wild and unwittingly generated gossip. After meeting the Blythe children in Rainbow Valley, Faith and her family formed a deep and lasting friendship with them. Following a series of misunderstood escapades—including a mix-up over days of the week that led them to clean house on a Sunday—Faith publicly addressed the Glen St. Mary congregation after a service to explain the mistake and defend her father from blame. Soon after, distressed by rumors that the congregation might force her father out, she personally visited the notorious non-churchgoer Norman Douglas to persuade him to return to church, unexpectedly winning his friendship, financial support, and attendance. Deeply sorrowed when Aunt Martha killed her pet rooster Adam for a visiting minister's dinner, she was comforted by Rosemary West, who gifted her a canary. Faith participated enthusiastically in the children's self-governing 'Good-Conduct Club' to keep her family out of trouble. When her father began courting Rosemary West, Faith warmly supported the match, glad to welcome her as a loving presence into their lives.

_Sources: [v5 c2 P25](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0025), [v5 c2 P28](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0028), [v5 c4 P46](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0046), [v5 c4 P48](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0048), [v5 c10 P11](../source/v05-c10.md#nw-v05-c10-p0011), [v5 c12 P6](../source/v05-c12.md#nw-v05-c12-p0006), [v5 c16 P26](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0026), [v5 c16 P59](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0059), [v5 c19 P5](../source/v05-c19.md#nw-v05-c19-p0005), [v5 c20 P17](../source/v05-c20.md#nw-v05-c20-p0017), [v5 c20 P33](../source/v05-c20.md#nw-v05-c20-p0033), [v5 c23 P59](../source/v05-c23.md#nw-v05-c23-p0059), [v5 c34 P38](../source/v05-c34.md#nw-v05-c34-p0038)_

- Daughter of Rev. John Knox Meredith and the late Cecilia Meredith  <sub>[v5 c2 P7](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0007), [v5 c4 P8](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0008)</sub>
